race.comment: MONEY TEAM (2) appreciated the drop back to midweek company when a closing second over 1250m at the Kensington track last time out. Maps nicely just behind a strong tempo. Cherry ripe after four runs back and this looks a lovely assignment. UZZIAH (1) was nudged out of second spot by MONEY TEAM when fresh from a spell at the Kenso recently. Veteran with a strong second-up profile. Big chance to at least emulate the effort from last time. ELSON BOY (3) put a row of duck eggs behind him with a tough win over this track and trip last start. Can string a few together so expect him to kick on now. PROBABILITY THEORY (9) has won four from seven and is trialling well so a big first-up run looks on the cards. Scratched from another race to be kept for this. AMREEKIYAH (7) returns from a 137-day spell. Has won two from three when fresh in the past and a couple of recent trials should have her up to the mark.
